name: atomurus-site
description: Atomurus static site - Netlify build scripts (bump-version, build-i18n) run as CommonJS

scripts.build: node tools/build-home-preview-data.js && node tools/build-i18n-assets.js && node tools/build-element-content-chunks.js && node tools/generate-isomerism-pt-variants.js && node bump-version.js && node build-i18n.js
